claims: Braylon Mullins was a 5-star shooting guard at Greenfield-Central High School in Greenfield, Indiana.
Braylon Mullins graduated from Greenfield-Central High School in 2025.
Braylon Mullins averaged 35.2 points per game as a senior.
Braylon Mullins averaged 7.7 rebounds per game as a senior.
Braylon Mullins averaged 3.9 steals per game as a senior.
Braylon Mullins finished as Greenfield-Central High School's all-time leading scorer with 2,158 points.
Braylon Mullins was named Indiana Mr. Basketball in 2025.
